articles.title_cn: 学生-学校匹配中的相关性忽视
articles.abstract_en: We present results from three experiments containing incentivized school choice scenarios. In these scenarios, we vary whether schools’ assessments of students are based on a common priority (inducing correlation in admissions decisions) or are based on independent assessments (eliminating correlation in admissions decisions). The quality of students’ application strategies declines in the presence of correlated admissions: application strategies become substantially more aggressive and fail to include attractive “safety” options. We provide a battery of tests suggesting that this phenomenon is at least partially driven by correlation neglect, and we discuss implications for the design and deployment of student-to-school matching mechanisms. (JEL C78, C91, D82, I23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了三个包含激励性择校场景的实验结果。在这些场景中，我们改变学校的评估是基于共同优先级（导致录取决策中的相关性）还是基于独立评估（消除录取决策中的相关性）。学生申请策略的质量在存在相关录取时下降：申请策略变得明显更具攻击性，并且未能包含有吸引力的“安全”选项。我们提供了一系列测试，表明这一现象至少部分由相关性忽视驱动，并讨论了这对学生-学校匹配机制设计和部署的启示。（JEL C78, C91, D82, I23）

articles.title_en: Communicating about Confidence: Cheap Talk with an Ambiguity-Averse Receiver
articles.title_cn: 沟通信心：面对模糊厌恶接收者的廉价交谈
articles.abstract_en: An expert, who is only informed of the probability of possible states, communicates with a decision-maker through cheap talk. The decision-maker considers different probability distributions over states as possible and is ambiguity averse. I show that all equilibria of the game are equivalent to partitional ones and that the most informative is interim dominant for the expert. Information transmission regarding probabilities that are bad news for the decision-maker is facilitated by ambiguity aversion. However, ambiguity aversion also makes information transmission impossible, whatever the preference misalignment, regarding probabilities that are good news for him. (JEL C72, D81, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 一位仅知晓可能状态概率的专家，通过廉价交谈与决策者沟通。决策者认为多种概率分布可能，且具有模糊厌恶。我证明该博弈的所有均衡等价于分割均衡，且信息量最大的均衡对专家而言是中期占优的。关于对决策者不利消息的概率的信息传递因模糊厌恶而得到促进。然而，无论偏好分歧如何，模糊厌恶也使得关于对决策者有利消息的概率的信息传递变得不可能。(JEL C72, D81, D83)

articles.title_en: The Dynamic Effects of Recycling on Oligopoly Competition: Evidence from the US Paper Industry
articles.title_cn: 回收对寡头竞争动态效应：来自美国造纸业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Consumer recycling generates new intermediate inputs. If some of the inputs are used to manufacture a substitute for the original product, the primary seller faces an incentive to reduce current output and raise rivals’ future costs. I find that firms in the US paper industry facing exposure to future competition from the recycled sector, based on differences between product specific recycling technologies, reduced output more than firms not exposed to the recycled sector as consumer recycling increased. I then use the model to illustrate how the strategic response to recycling affects environmental policy. (JEL D43, L13, L73, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 消费者回收产生新的中间投入品。如果部分投入品被用于制造原产品的替代品，主要卖方将面临减少当前产量并提高竞争对手未来成本的激励。我发现，美国造纸业中面临来自回收部门未来竞争的企业，基于产品特定回收技术的差异，在消费者回收增加时，其产量减少幅度大于未面临回收部门竞争的企业。随后，我利用该模型说明对回收的战略反应如何影响环境政策。（JEL D43, L13, L73, Q53, Q58）

articles.title_en: Concentration and Geographic Proximity in Antitrust Policy: Evidence from Bank Mergers
articles.title_cn: 反垄断政策中的集中度与地理邻近性：来自银行并购的证据
articles.abstract_en: Antitrust often uses the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) for merger screening and review. We argue that HHI-based antitrust policy using predefined markets in the banking industry misses anticompetitive effects that are predicted by the proximity of merging branch networks. Difference-in-differences estimates from thousands of mergers reveal that close-proximity bank acquisitions have harmful effects, including branch closures, even if they fall below the HHI threshold for enforcement. Neither lowering the threshold nor using narrower predefined markets addresses this underenforcement without introducing significant overenforcement and underenforcement of other transactions. However, using a proximity threshold to complement the HHI policy could improve bank antitrust. (JEL G21, G28, G34, K21, L13, L41)
articles.abstract_cn: 反垄断通常使用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）进行并购筛查和审查。我们认为，基于HHI的反垄断政策在银行业中使用预定义市场，会遗漏由并购分支网络邻近性所预测的反竞争效应。来自数千起并购的双重差分估计显示，近距离的银行收购会产生有害影响，包括分支关闭，即使它们低于HHI执法阈值。降低阈值或使用更窄的预定义市场都无法解决这种执法不足，而不会对其他交易引入显著的过度执法和执法不足。然而，使用邻近性阈值作为HHI政策的补充可以改善银行反垄断。（JEL G21, G28, G34, K21, L13, L41）

articles.abstract_en: A principal incentivizes a group of agents to work by choosing a monitoring structure and a scheme of performance-contingent rewards. The monitoring structure partitions the set of agents into monitoring teams, each delivering a signal of joint performance. We show that unlike under partial implementation, the principal always exhausts her monitoring capacity to optimally implement work as a unique outcome. Optimal monitoring teams are homogeneous between them: equally sized and with agents allocated in an anti-assortative fashion. Higher-effort-cost agents receive lower rents, and they tend to be monitored more closely than lower-effort-cost agents when the principal’s allocation is constrained. (JEL D82, D86, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人通过选择监督结构和绩效挂钩的奖励方案来激励一组代理人工作。监督结构将代理人集合划分为监督团队，每个团队提供联合绩效的信号。我们表明，与部分实施不同，委托人总是用尽其监督能力，以最优方式将工作作为唯一结果实施。最优监督团队之间是同质的：规模相等，且代理人以反分类的方式分配。高努力成本的代理人获得较低的租金，并且当委托人的分配受到约束时，他们往往比低努力成本的代理人受到更密切的监督。(JEL D82, D86, M54)

articles.title_en: Everyday Econometricians: Selection Neglect and Overoptimism When Learning from Others
articles.title_cn: 日常计量经济学家：向他人学习时的选择忽视与过度乐观
articles.abstract_en: This study explores selection neglect in an experimental investment game where individuals can learn from others’ outcomes. Experiment 1 examines aggregate-level equilibrium behavior. We find strong evidence of selection neglect and corroborate several comparative static predictions of Jehiel’s (2018) model, showing that the severity of the bias is aggravated by the sophistication of other individuals and moderated when information is more correlated across individuals. Experiment 2 focuses on individual decision-making, isolating the influence of beliefs from possible confounding factors. This allows us to classify individuals according to their degree of naïvety and explore the limits of, and potential remedies for, selection neglect. (JEL C91, D12, D83, D91, G41)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在实验性投资游戏中，个体可以从他人的结果中学习时的选择忽视。实验1考察了总体层面的均衡行为。我们发现了选择忽视的有力证据，并证实了Jehiel（2018）模型的几个比较静态预测，表明该偏差的严重程度因其他个体的 sophistication 而加剧，并在个体间信息更相关时得到缓和。实验2侧重于个体决策，将信念的影响与可能的混淆因素隔离开来。这使我们能够根据个体的天真程度对其进行分类，并探讨选择忽视的局限性及潜在补救措施。（JEL C91, D12, D83, D91, G41）

articles.title_en: Intelligence Disclosure and Cooperation in Repeated Interactions
articles.title_cn: 智力披露与重复互动中的合作
articles.abstract_en: How does information about players’ intelligence affect strategic behavior? Game theory, based on the assumption of common knowledge of rationality, does not provide useful predictions. We experimentally show that, in the Prisoner’s Dilemma, disclosure hampers cooperation: higher-intelligence players trust their partners less when playing against someone of lower ability. Similarly, in the Battle of Sexes with low payoff inequality, disclosure disrupts coordination, as higher-intelligence players try to force their most preferred outcome. Instead, with higher payoff inequality, behavior changes and higher-intelligence players concede. We analyze the reasons for these patterns of behavior. (JEL C72, C73, C92, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 关于玩家智力的信息如何影响战略行为？基于理性共同知识假设的博弈论并未提供有用的预测。我们通过实验表明，在囚徒困境中，披露会阻碍合作：高智力玩家在与低能力对手对弈时更不信任对方。同样，在低收益不平等的性别之战中，披露会破坏协调，因为高智力玩家试图强制实现自己最偏好的结果。相反，在较高收益不平等的情况下，行为发生变化，高智力玩家会让步。我们分析了这些行为模式的原因。（JEL C72, C73, C92, D83, D91）

articles.title_en: Negotiating Cooperation under Uncertainty: Communication in Noisy, Indefinitely Repeated Interactions
articles.title_cn: 不确定性下的合作谈判：噪声、无限重复互动中的沟通
articles.abstract_en: Case studies of cartels and recent theory suggest that communication is a key factor for cooperation under imperfect monitoring, where actions can only be observed with noise. We conduct a laboratory experiment to study how communication affects cooperation under different monitoring structures. Pre-play communication reduces strategic uncertainty and facilitates very high cooperation rates at the beginning of an interaction. Under perfect monitoring, this is sufficient to reach a high and stable cooperation rate. However, repeated communication is important to maintain a high level of cooperation under imperfect monitoring, where players face additional uncertainty about the history of play. (JEL C72, C73, D81, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 卡特尔案例研究和近期理论表明，在不完美监督下，即行动只能被带有噪声地观察时，沟通是合作的关键因素。我们进行了一项实验室实验，研究不同监督结构下沟通如何影响合作。事前沟通减少了策略不确定性，并在互动初期促进了非常高的合作率。在完美监督下，这足以达到高且稳定的合作率。然而，在不完美监督下，玩家面临关于游戏历史的额外不确定性，重复沟通对于维持高水平的合作至关重要。(JEL C72, C73, D81, D82, D83)

articles.title_en: Beliefs, Learning, and Personality in the Indefinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
articles.title_cn: 无限重复囚徒困境中的信念、学习与人格
articles.abstract_en: We aim to understand the role and evolution of beliefs in the indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma (IRPD). To do so, we elicit beliefs about the supergame strategies chosen by others. We find heterogeneity in beliefs and changes in beliefs with experience are central to understanding behavior and learning in the IRPD. Beliefs strongly predict cooperation, beliefs respond to the return to cooperation, most subjects choose strategies that perform well given their beliefs, and beliefs change with experience while becoming more accurate over time. Finally, we uncover a novel mechanism whereby trusting subjects learn to cooperate through their interaction with experience. (JEL C72, C73, C91, D83, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们旨在理解无限重复囚徒困境（IRPD）中信念的作用与演变。为此，我们引出了关于他人所选择的超级博弈策略的信念。我们发现信念的异质性以及信念随经验的变化对于理解IRPD中的行为和学习至关重要。信念强烈预测合作，信念对合作的回报作出反应，大多数受试者根据其信念选择表现良好的策略，并且信念随经验而变化，同时随时间变得更加准确。最后，我们揭示了一种新颖的机制，即信任型受试者通过其与经验的互动学会合作。（JEL C72, C73, C91, D83, D91）

articles.abstract_en: An increasing number of monopolization cases have been constructed around the notion of “must-have” items: products that distributors must carry to “compete effectively.” Motivated by these cases, we consider a multiproduct setting where upstream suppliers sell their products through competing distributors offering one-stop-shopping convenience to consumers. We show the emergence of products that distributors cannot afford not to carry if their rivals do. A supplier of such products can exploit this must-have property, along with tying and exclusivity provisions, to monopolize adjacent, otherwise-competitive markets. Policy interventions that ban tying or exclusivity provisions may prove ineffective or even backfire. (JEL D43, K21, L13, L14, L42, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的垄断化案例围绕“必备品”概念构建：即分销商为了“有效竞争”而必须持有的产品。受这些案例的启发，我们考虑一个多产品设定，其中上游供应商通过相互竞争的分销商销售其产品，这些分销商为消费者提供一站式购物便利。我们展示了当竞争对手持有某些产品时，分销商无法不持有这些产品的现象的出现。此类产品的供应商可以利用这种必备属性，结合捆绑销售和排他性条款，来垄断相邻的、原本竞争激烈的市场。禁止捆绑销售或排他性条款的政策干预可能被证明无效，甚至适得其反。(JEL D43, K21, L13, L14, L42, L81)

articles.title_en: Limited Strategic Thinking and the Cursed Match
articles.title_cn: 有限战略思维与受诅咒的匹配
articles.abstract_en: In vertically differentiated matching markets with private information, agents face an acceptance curse: being accepted as a partner conveys bad news. We experimentally investigate whether individuals anticipate the acceptance curse in such an environment. We test the effect of an exogenous change in reservation values, making some types more selective and inducing significant changes in the posterior distribution of match qualities. Consistent with limited strategic sophistication, subjects don’t respond to this manipulation. Through additional investigation and structural estimations, we suggest a mechanism explaining the lack of subjects’ response: out-of-equilibrium beliefs are quantitatively more important than limited conditional thinking. (JEL C78, C91, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有私人信息的纵向差异化匹配市场中，代理人面临一种接受诅咒：作为合作伙伴被接受传递了坏消息。我们通过实验研究个体在此类环境中是否预期到接受诅咒。我们测试了保留价值外生变化的影响，使某些类型更具选择性，并引发匹配质量后验分布的显著变化。与有限战略复杂性一致，受试者对此操纵没有反应。通过额外调查和结构估计，我们提出了一种解释受试者缺乏反应的机制：非均衡信念在数量上比有限条件思维更重要。（JEL C78, C91, D82）

articles.title_en: Dynamic Oligopoly Pricing with Asymmetric Information: Implications for Horizontal Mergers
articles.title_cn: 不对称信息下的动态寡头定价：对横向并购的启示
articles.abstract_en: We model repeated pricing by differentiated product firms when each firm has private information about its serially correlated marginal cost. In a fully separating equilibrium of the dynamic game, signaling incentives can lead equilibrium prices to be significantly above those in a static, complete information game, even when the possible variation in the privately observed state variables is very limited. We calibrate our model using data from the beer industry and show that, without any change in conduct, our model can explain increases in price levels and changes in price dynamics and cost pass-through after the 2008 MillerCoors joint venture. (JEL C73, D43, D82, G34, L24, L41, L66)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了差异化产品企业在各自拥有关于其序列相关边际成本的私人信息时的重复定价行为。在动态博弈的完全分离均衡中，即使私下观测到的状态变量可能的变化非常有限，信号传递激励也可能导致均衡价格显著高于静态、完全信息博弈中的价格。我们使用啤酒行业的数据校准了我们的模型，并表明，在行为没有任何变化的情况下，我们的模型可以解释2008年MillerCoors合资企业之后价格水平的上升以及价格动态和成本传导的变化。(JEL C73, D43, D82, G34, L24, L41, L66)

articles.title_en: Dynamic Incentives and Permit Market Equilibrium in Cap-and-Trade Regulation
articles.title_cn: 总量控制与交易规制中的动态激励与许可证市场均衡
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic structural model of emissions abatement, investment, and permit trading with banking under cap-and-trade regulation. The model accounts for forward-looking behavior and transaction costs in the permit market, which determine the temporal and geographical distribution of emissions in equilibrium and, thus, the welfare implications of the regulation. The model is applied to the US Acid Rain Program to evaluate the role of regulatory designs. Permit banking mitigates inefficiencies arising from transaction costs and modifies the timing of emissions. An emissions tax policy could achieve an outcome close to dynamic cap and trade without transaction costs. (JEL D23, H23, L94, L98, Q52, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建并估计了一个在总量控制与交易规制下，包含排放削减、投资和许可证交易（含银行机制）的动态结构模型。该模型考虑了前瞻性行为和许可证市场中的交易成本，这些因素决定了均衡状态下排放的时间与地理分布，进而影响规制的福利效应。该模型被应用于美国酸雨计划，以评估不同规制设计的作用。许可证银行机制缓解了交易成本带来的低效率，并改变了排放的时间安排。一项排放税政策可以实现接近无交易成本动态总量控制与交易的结果。（JEL D23, H23, L94, L98, Q52, Q53, Q58）

articles.title_en: A Kinky Consistency: Experimental Evidence of Behavior under Linear and Nonlinear Budget Constraints
articles.title_cn: 一种扭结的一致性：线性和非线性预算约束下行为的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Individuals face nonlinear incentives in myriad situations. We test a fundamental assumption in such settings: that individuals display stable preferences when facing linear and nonlinear incentives. We use a laboratory experiment to characterize how revealed preferences are affected by changes in the budget set environment. Choices under kinked budgets exhibit the same very high levels of internally consistent behavior as they do under linear budgets. However, for about half the subjects, choices across settings are inconsistent with the maximization of a stable preference. Subjects displaying arbitrary consistency exhibit large and significant changes in utility parameters, risk premiums, and price elasticities across settings. (JEL C91, D12, D81, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 个体在众多情境中面临非线性激励。我们检验了此类情境中的一个基本假设：即个体在面对线性和非线性激励时表现出稳定的偏好。我们使用实验室实验来刻画揭示性偏好如何受预算集环境变化的影响。在扭结预算下的选择表现出与线性预算下相同的高水平内部一致性行为。然而，对于大约一半的受试者，跨情境的选择与稳定偏好的最大化不一致。表现出任意一致性的受试者在不同情境中的效用参数、风险溢价和价格弹性上表现出显著且重大的变化。(JEL C91, D12, D81, D91)

articles.title_en: Public Debt and the Political Economy of Reforms
articles.title_cn: 公共债务与改革的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: How do electoral incentives influence the choice to experiment with a policy reform that generates uncertain future benefits? To answer this question, we examine a two-period model of redistributive politics with uncertain policy outcomes involving a mixture of private and public benefits. In equilibrium, we find that the intertemporal trade-off between current policy costs and future benefits creates an incentive for politicians to use public debt to smooth spending across periods. The higher the share of policy benefits that are in the form of a public good, the higher the level of available debt-related spending on targeted policies that is necessary. (JEL D63, D72, E23, H41, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 选举激励如何影响对产生不确定未来收益的政策改革进行试验的选择？为回答这一问题，我们考察了一个包含不确定政策结果（涉及私人和公共利益的混合）的两期再分配政治模型。在均衡中，我们发现当前政策成本与未来收益之间的跨期权衡促使政治家利用公共债务来平滑各期支出。政策收益中作为公共品形式存在的份额越高，用于目标政策的可用债务相关支出水平就越高。（JEL D63, D72, E23, H41, H63）

articles.title_en: Selling Dreams: Endogenous Optimism in Lending Markets
articles.title_cn: 贩卖梦想：贷款市场中的内生乐观主义
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of borrower optimism in competitive lending markets with asymmetric information. Borrowers engage in self-deception to arrive at beliefs that optimally trade off the anticipatory utility benefits and material costs of optimism. Lenders’ contract design shapes these benefits and costs. The model yields three key results. First, the borrower’s motivated cognition increases her material welfare, which explains why it is not driven out of markets. Second, in line with empirical evidence, a low cost of lending and a booming economy lead to optimism and the widespread collateralization of loans. Third, equilibrium collateral requirements may be inefficiently high. (JEL D82, D86, D91, G21, G31, G51, L26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个在信息不对称的竞争性贷款市场中借款人乐观主义的模型。借款人进行自我欺骗，以达到在预期效用收益和乐观主义的物质成本之间最优权衡的信念。贷款人的合同设计塑造了这些收益和成本。该模型产生了三个关键结果。首先，借款人的动机性认知增加了她的物质福利，这解释了为什么它不会被市场淘汰。其次，与经验证据一致，低贷款成本和繁荣的经济导致乐观主义和贷款的广泛抵押化。第三，均衡抵押要求可能低效地高。(JEL D82, D86, D91, G21, G31, G51, L26)
